support.label: Take a supportive action
support.headline: What would you like to do today?
support.giftNote: Arrives on her phone right away as a card she can open.
support.giftComingSoon: Real flowers and chocolates, delivered to her door, are coming soon.
support.callNote: We’ll check back later so you can tick it off.
support.noteDisclaimer: Arrives as a notification. Not saved anywhere.

join.claimedBody: Each invite works for one person. Ask her to send a new link if it should have been you.
join.inactiveBody: It may have expired, or been replaced by a newer one. Ask her to share it again.
join.signInNote: If you joined before, your number still works — you do not need a new link.
join.intro: You will see how she is doing — trends only, never her records, notes, or conversations. She can stop sharing at any time.
join.phoneHint: We send a one-time code to confirm it is you. Your number is never shown to her in full.

signIn.title: Sign in to keep supporting her
signIn.intro: Use the mobile number you confirmed when you joined. We will send a one-time code.
signIn.neverJoined: Never joined before? You need the invite link she sends you.

install.homeScreenNote: Look for the <1>Anuva Family</1> icon on your home screen. If it asks for your number again, it is the same one-time code — your phone is what signs you in.
install.promptTitle: One last step: add the app
install.promptBody: Anuva Family lives on your home screen. That is how we can tell you when she opens your note — a browser tab cannot.
install.promptDismissed: That did not finish. Tap the button again, or open your browser menu and choose <1>Install app</1> or <3>Add to Home screen</3>.
install.justInstalledBody: Open Anuva Family from your home screen to carry on. Your browser cannot open it for you, so this last tap is yours.
install.alreadyInstalledBody: Anuva Family is on this device already. Open it from your home screen rather than this tab — notifications only reach you there.
install.inAppTitle: Open this page in your browser
install.inAppBodyNamed: {{app}}'s built-in browser cannot add apps to your home screen. Reopen this page in Safari or Chrome and you are two taps from done.
install.inAppBody: This in-app browser cannot add apps to your home screen. Reopen this page in Safari or Chrome and you are two taps from done.
install.inAppStep1: Tap the menu button in the corner of this screen.
install.inAppStep2: Choose <1>Open in browser</1>, <3>Open in Safari</3>, or <5>Open in Chrome</5>.
install.inAppStep3: Come back to this page and add Anuva Family.
install.iosTitle: Add Anuva Family to your home screen
install.iosBody: On iPhone this is done from Safari's Share menu. Two taps, and the icon is on your home screen.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button <1/> at the bottom of Safari.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap <1>Add to Home Screen</1>.
install.iosStep3: Tap <1>Add</1>, then open Anuva Family from your home screen.
install.iosNoShare: No Share button? You are probably still inside WhatsApp. Tap the ••• or compass icon in the corner and choose <1>Open in Safari</1> first.
install.manualTitle: One last step: add the app
install.manualBody: Anuva Family runs from your home screen. Your browser has not offered a button for it, so add it from the browser menu.
install.manualStep2: Choose <1>Install app</1> or <3>Add to Home screen</3>.
install.manualStep3: Open Anuva Family from your home screen.
install.manualFallback: If that option is not there, open this page in Chrome or Safari.

notifications.title: Know when it lands
notifications.body: When she opens your flowers or your note and taps thank you, we will send you a smiley. That, and a gentle nudge if you asked to be reminded this evening. Nothing else.

thanks.bodyFallback: She saw what you did today, and it landed.
thanks.title: {{name}} says thank you

crash.title: Something went wrong on our end
crash.body: Nothing you did caused this. Reloading usually sorts it out, and anything you sent her has already gone through.

beta.previewAlt: What will be sent with this report
beta.sentBody: We can see exactly what your screen was doing.
beta.messagePlaceholder: A few words is plenty — or just send it.
beta.noTransport: This build has no reporting configured, so nothing was sent. Please pass this on to the team directly.
beta.viewPicture: View the picture that will be sent
beta.noPictureNote: The report still helps — we can replay what happened.
beta.tapForFullSize: Tap it to see it full size.
